comment: These are 2 of the key public health challenges of our time. Why are we focussed solely on these and not on the others - vaccine hesitancy, NCDs, AMR, environemental pollution, etc?Suggest to revise this goal to make it focussed on holistic public health, covering the spectrum of health promotion, disease prevention, health protection, and surveillance. This will then cover all the major public health challenges, including emergency preparedness and response.
